title: Social media in 2026: saturation, passive consumption, and AI-shaped behavior
discussion_signal: The post frames social media as mature rather than simply expanding, with users moving across multiple platforms while consuming more and posting less. It also identifies AI and skepticism as forces reshaping how connectivity becomes a social utility.
linked_research_question: How are connectivity, sociality, and AI expanding together while access, attention, and agency remain uneven?
limits: Post synthesizes multiple reports and is not itself a primary survey
Claims are not independently re-estimated here
Platform use and attention do not establish social wellbeing
